title: Canyon Stream Folk Aesthetic
coreRelationships: The winding white water creates a leading line from the center-top to the bottom-right.
Dark, wet rock faces provide a high-contrast frame for the bright river.
Vibrant green moss and ferns soften the hard edges of the stone canyon walls.
Typography is anchored in the upper third, overlapping the dark forest canopy.
reuseFormula: Nature Photography + Top-Centered Dual-Font Typography (Serif/Script) + High Contrast Water/Rock
